I will deliver it immediately. And prepare my ship.''"
"''What should we do with these two?''"
"''Wipe their memory and dump them back in the street! They'll find their way back home. We can't have anything… looking out of place, can we?|Cad Bane and HELIOS-3E, regarding R2-D2 and C-3PO|}} After being instructed to recover the plans for the [[Imperial Executive Building|Republic Executive Building]], [[Cad Bane]] brought HELIOS-3E to [[Coruscant]]. When [[Todo 360]] successfully separated [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[protocol droid]], [[C-3PO]], from his counterpart, [[R2-D2]], 3E pulled up in a speeder so they could bring 3PO to Bane. After discovering that R2 was the droid that had the information for the Republic Executive Building, he was sent with Todo to track him down. After searching for the [[Astromech droid|astromech]], they decided to return, empty-handed, to Bane. When R2-D2 heard about them torturing C-3PO, he gave himself up to prevent his companion from becoming spare parts. Soon, the plans were extracted from the little droid, and 3E was charged with wiping their memories and "dumping them back on the streets." Later, 3E assisted Bane by guarding the hostages during the [[Senate hostage crisis]], and later successfully left the crime scene with the other members of the team and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]. ==Personality and traits== HELIOS-3E was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid]] who worked as a [[bounty hunter]] as part of [[Cad Bane's group]]. 3E had [[Gender|masculine]] programming and was 1.96 [[meter]]s, or 6 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches tall. HELIOS-3E displayed some measure of fear toward Cad Bane, knowing that his master would not be pleased if he and Todo 360 failed to capture R2-D2. ==Skills and abilities== 3E was an [[assassin droid]], who was skilled in combat and as a pilot, had knowledge of military tactics, and was effective at [[Slicer|data slicing]]. ==Equipment== 3E was armed with a [[Weequay blaster lance|long-barreled blaster rifle]]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Evil Plans}} {{1stID|HELIOS-3E}} *{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|1|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|4|Databank A-Z}} {{Imo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|30|Weapons & Uniforms}} *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 3|cardname=HELIOS-3E}} {{C|Visual misidentification of an [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)|Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid]]}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ヘリオス3E }} [[Category:Cad Bane's group]] [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:IG-86 sentinel droids]] [[Category:Pilots]]
